finalText:
It's building clean now. Two real bugs from the bump, both in how modules read the new bundler's config shape.

`src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. It crashed on `undefined.toFixed()`.

`src/net/retryPolicy.js` only accepted `true` or `false` for the backoff flag. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined`, so it threw instead of just treating that as off.

Fixed both. Build now exits 0 with 8 warnings, all deprecation noise, no errors.
